desc: Read input and store the intervals; compute `cnt[v]` for v in [1, MAXV] (MAXV = 500000) by incrementing a difference array on the intervals.
Build jump table `up[k][v]` for k = 0..LOG-1, where `up[0][v] = v + cnt[v]` (ensure v does not exceed array size, cap at MAXV+N+1), and `up[k][v] = up[k-1][ up[k-1][v] ]`.
Answer each query X by iterating k from LOG-1 down to 0, and if `up[k][cur] != cur`, set `cur = up[k][cur]`. Print `cur`.

Output all answers, one per line. Ensure to handle the case where `cnt[v]` is computed up to MAXV and treat cnt[v]=0 for v > MAXV (i.e., up[0][v] = v for those v). Set array size to `MAX = 500000 + N + 5` to be safe.

Verify that the allocated array size `S = MAX_R + N + 5` is sufficient for all intermediate ratings, and that the binary lifting table correctly handles values at the boundary (e.g., when `v + cnt[v] > S`, cap to `S` to prevent index errors).
Test the solution on the provided sample inputs to ensure correct output.
